title: Options
subtitle: BTC and ETH listed options from Deribit — open interest, volume, put/call, implied vol, dealer gamma, and where that disagrees with spot or futures.

expiry.title: Expiry distribution
expiry.legend: Click an expiry · bar width is share of OI · green = calls · red = puts

detail.payoutLegend: Total call + put intrinsic if price expires at that strike. Highlight is the lowest.

gamma.title: Dealer gamma
gamma.subtitle: Where market makers are long or short gamma — stabler below a long book, faster when they are short
gamma.netHint: Calls {{call}} · puts {{put}} · USD delta per 1% move

regimeHint.long: Dealers long gamma — they fade moves
regimeHint.short: Dealers short gamma — moves can run faster
regimeHint.flat: Call and put gamma nearly cancel

gamma.flipEmpty: No zero crossing in the nearby strikes
gamma.profileLegend: Green = long gamma (stabler) · red = short (faster). Solid outline is the flip; dashed is spot.
gamma.empty: No dealer gamma yet. Needs listed strikes with mark IV.

vol.title: Volatility structure
vol.subtitle: ATM IV by expiry, and put minus call at the money
vol.skewLegend: Green = call · red = put · number is put − call

moves.title: Important options moves
moves.subtitle: Shown only when open interest, put/call, implied vol, or dealer gamma changes much more than usual in a short time

history.title: Over time
history.subtitle: How open interest, put/call, DVOL vs 30-day realized, and dealer gamma moved in the last hours and days
history.empty: No history yet. Implied vol fills from Deribit; open interest, put/call, and gamma appear after the desk has been running.
history.collectingSeries: Still collecting this series. Check back after the desk has been running for a few hours.
history.emptyGamma: No dealer-gamma history yet. Check back after the desk has been running.
history.hint: OI, put/call, and dealer gamma are sampled while this backend runs. Implied vol uses Deribit DVOL history and overlays 30-day realized from daily closes. Flip chart overlays the index so you can see when spot crossed the flip.

vs.title: Options vs the rest of the market
vs.subtitle: Shown only when implied vol or put/call lean disagrees with spot range or futures positioning
